identities.label: Durdzuks
identities.description: Medieval exonym of the 9th-18th centuries used in Georgian and Arabic sources in reference to the Ingush and Chechen peoples
identities.summary: The Durdzuks (Georgian: დურძუკები, romanized: durdzuk'ebi), also known as Dzurdzuks, was a medieval exonym of the 9th-18th centuries used mainly in Georgian, Arabic, but also Armenian sources in reference to the Vainakh peoples (Chechens and Ingush).
